Bash(node scripts/db-query.mjs --sql "WITH b AS \(SELECT stock_code, FIRST\(close ORDER BY trading_date\) AS awal, LAST\(close ORDER BY trading_date\) AS akhir, FIRST\(trading_date ORDER BY trading_date\)::VARCHAR AS d1, LAST\(trading_date ORDER BY trading_date\)::VARCHAR AS d2, ROUND\(\(EXP\(SUM\(LN\(1+GREATEST\(COALESCE\(change_percent,0\),-99\)/100.0\)\)\)-1\)*100,2\) AS ret_compound FROM market.daily_transactions WHERE stock_code IN \('BBCA','BBRI','TLKM','ASII','BMRI'\) AND trading_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY stock_code\) SELECT stock_code, d1, awal, d2, akhir, ROUND\(\(akhir/awal-1\)*100,2\) AS ret_harga_pct, ret_compound FROM b ORDER BY stock_code")

Bash(node scripts/db-query.mjs --sql "WITH latest AS \(SELECT MAX\(trading_date\) AS d FROM market.daily_transactions\) SELECT \(SELECT d FROM latest\)::VARCHAR AS trading_date, COUNT\(*\)::INTEGER AS n, SUM\(CASE WHEN change_percent > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\)::INTEGER AS naik, SUM\(CASE WHEN change_percent < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\)::INTEGER AS turun, ROUND\(AVG\(change_percent\)::DOUBLE, 2\) AS avg_chg FROM market.daily_transactions dt CROSS JOIN latest l WHERE dt.trading_date = l.d AND dt.value >= 1000000000")
